name: @pipeworx/mcp-oig-self-disclosure-settlements

tools.name: oig_sdp_recent
tools.description: The most recent HHS-OIG Self-Disclosure Protocol settlements — providers (and, separately, grantees/contractors) who voluntarily self-disclosed conduct to OIG and agreed to pay a Civil Monetary Penalties Law settlement to resolve it. Different from a Corporate Integrity Agreement (mcps/oig-corporate-integrity): most SDP settlements carry no ongoing compliance obligation, just a one-time payment. Returns totals first — the matching count, the corpus totals by program, and the approximate dollar sum of the returned page (headline figures, sometimes rounded) — then the settlements themselves, newest first: provider, date, headline amount, allegation and a detail-page link. Sourced from HHS-OIG, keyless.

program.description: "provider" for Provider Self-Disclosure Protocol settlements (the large majority, ~1,057), "grant" for Grant and Contractor Self-Disclosure Program settlements (~17), or "all" (default).

tools.name: oig_sdp_check
tools.description: Has this provider, grantee, or contractor settled a case under HHS-OIG's Self-Disclosure Protocol or Grant Self-Disclosure Program? Checks a name against the current list of settled self-disclosure enforcement actions — an exact title match is the strongest signal; a provider-name or token match is returned as a labelled CANDIDATE. For the best match, fetches the settlement's own detail page LIVE to return the exact settlement amount, the full entity description, and the complete allegation narrative — none of that is baked, so it is never stale (the headline figure is often a rounded approximation of it). Returns found:false with the list's as-of date and total settlement count when no match exists. Sourced from HHS-OIG, keyless.

name.description: Provider, grantee, or contractor name to check, e.g. "Baptist Health Brookwood Hospital". Any word order; partial names are matched as candidates.

program.description: Restrict the search to one program (default "all").

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return (default 5, max 20). Only the top/best candidate is enriched with live detail-page data.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-oig-self-disclosure-settlements forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the oig-self-disclosure-settlements pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
